Definition: adverb from G5140; three times:--three times, thrice.
BiblicalUsage: Paul counts his sufferings in threes, and Peter's vision came down three times. Thrice was Paul beaten with rods, thrice he suffered shipwreck, and the sheet was let down thrice before it was received up again into heaven.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the repeated number joins the two stories: what Paul endured three times over, God showed Peter three times over.
